header.superHtml:
It’s a bird, it’s a plane, it’s…Turbo! Dr. HaveOneSuperSmile’s super jet sidekick defends mouths and keeps Cavitar’s sugar bugs at bay with his supersonic brushing speeds. Turbo blasts off built-up plaque and tartar with his super soft and patent-pending bristles and keeps little supers brushing for two minutes with a built-in timer.

  • sonic toothbrush vibrates gently for two minutes (the dentist-recommended brushing time) to soothe teething gums
  • brush lights up to inside teething mouths
  • soft nylon "S" shaped bristles remove plaque and clean gums
  • replaceable battery (requires one AA battery)
  • recommended for ages: 2-12 years

items.title: BEST ELECTRIC TOOTHBRUSH FOR TODDLERS
items.quote: “This toothbrush has incredibly soft bristles, which is nice for toddlers and young kids who are still learning how to brush. It’s also recommended for ages 2 to 12, while many electric other toothbrushes are intended for older ages. The superhero design and light help to make brushing fun, especially for toddlers who are often resistant to brushing their teeth.”
